description: This file defines a Dart class 'WorkoutsRepository' that manages workout data, either using mock data or interacting with a REST API client for CRUD operations.

classes.name: WorkoutsRepository
classes.description: Repository class responsible for managing workout data, providing methods to list and create workouts, either via mock data or through API calls.

methods.name: listWorkouts
methods.description: Fetches a list of workouts, returning mock data if configured, otherwise retrieving data from the REST API.

methods.name: createWorkout
methods.description: Creates a new workout entry, returning mock data if configured, otherwise sending data to the REST API.
